description_en: The machine asynchronous translation job creation API supports translation of up to 1 million characters.
description_zh: 机器异步翻译创建任务接口，支持100万以下字符翻译
kebab_example: aliyun alimt create-async-translate --source-language en --target-language zh --source-text Opinion:_We_have_finally_gotten_some_relief_at_the_pump._But_it_may_not_last_long --scene general --format-type text --api-type translate_standard --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAsyncTranslate

parameters.help_en: Source language. For language codes, see Language Code Reference (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158269.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.6.542.7da22b9fayuNoj).
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: Target language. For language codes, see the reference
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.example: Opinion: We have finally gotten some relief at the pump. But it may not last long
parameters.name: source_text

parameters.help_en: Scenario. Supported values include: general, title (product title), description (product description), message (buyer-seller communication), medical, social, and tech.
parameters.help_zh: 场景，支持：通用（general）、商品标题（title）、商品详情（description）、买卖家沟通（message）、医疗（medical）、社交（social）、科技（tech）
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en: The format of the text to translate: html (web page format; when this parameter is set, both the source text and the translated text are processed as HTML) or text (plain text format; when this parameter is set, neither the source text nor the translation result undergoes any formatting treatment and is uniformly handled as plain text)
parameters.help_zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en:
Version type. You must select one version:  

General-purpose Edition: translate_standard  

Professional Edition: translate_ecommerce
parameters.help_zh:
版本类型，必须选择一个版本

通用版本：translate_standard

专业版本：translate_ecommerce
parameters.name: api_type

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, used for troubleshooting.
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的唯一id，用于后续排查问题使用
